backend.retry:
<set-variable name="route" value="@{
                var hop = (string)context.Variables["attemptBackend"] + " (" + (string)context.Variables["attemptRegion"] + ") " + context.Response.StatusCode;
                var previous = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("route", "");
                return previous == "" ? hop : previous + " > " + hop;
            }" />
            <set-variable name="attempts" value="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("attempts", 0) + 1)" />

policies.outbound:
<emit-metric name="BackendAttempts" value="@((double)context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("attempts", 1))" namespace="ai-gateway-tokenomics">
            <dimension name="Backend" value="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("attemptBackend", "unknown"))" />
            <dimension name="Region" value="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("attemptRegion", "unknown"))" />
            <dimension name="Failover" value="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("attempts", 1) > 1 ? "yes" : "no")" />
            
            <dimension name="Model" value="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("servedModel", "unknown"))" />
            <dimension name="Tier" value="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("payerTier", "none"))" />
        
        
        
            
                <set-variable name="promptTokens" value="@{
                    var usage = context.Response.Body.As(preserveContent: true)["usage"];
                    if (usage == null) { return 0; }
                    var tokens = usage["prompt_tokens"] ?? usage["input_tokens"];
                    return tokens == null ? 0 : (int)tokens;
                }" />
                <set-variable name="completionTokens" value="@{
                    var usage = context.Response.Body.As(preserveContent: true)["usage"];
                    if (usage == null) { return 0; }
                    var tokens = usage["completion_tokens"] ?? usage["output_tokens"];
                    return tokens == null ? 0 : (int)tokens;
                }" />
                
                <set-variable name="costMicroUsd" value="@{
                    var model = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("servedModel", "");
                    double inputPrice = 0, outputPrice = 0;
                    foreach (var entry in ((string)context.Variables["modelPricing"]).Split(';')) {
                        var parts = entry.Split('=');
                        if (parts.Length == 2 && parts[0].Trim().Equals(model, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) {
                            var prices = parts[1].Split('/');
                            inputPrice = double.Parse(prices[0].Trim());
                            outputPrice = double.Parse(prices[1].Trim());
                        }
                    }
                    return (int)Math.Ceiling((int)context.Variables["promptTokens"] * inputPrice + (int)context.Variables["completionTokens"] * outputPrice);
                }" />
                
                    
                    
                    <dimension name="Model" value="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("servedModel", "unknown"))" />
                    
                    
                
                
                    @(((int)context.Variables["promptTokens"]).ToString())
                
                
                    @(((int)context.Variables["completionTokens"]).ToString())
                
                
                    @(((int)context.Variables["costMicroUsd"] / 1000000.0).ToString("0.000000"))
                
            
        
        
        
        
            @(context.Subscription?.Id ?? "anonymous")
        
        
            @(context.Product?.Id ?? "none")
        
        
            @(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("payer", ""))
        
        
            @(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("requestedModel", ""))
        
        
            @(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("servedModel", ""))
        
        
            @(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("governanceActions", "none"))
        
        
            @(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("route", ""))
        
        
            @(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("attemptBackend", ""))
        
        
            <when condition="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("route", "").Contains(" > "))">
                
                    @("Failover: " + (string)context.Variables["route"])
